title: Lodge an annual return for a charitable fundraising authority
summary: Find out how to lodge an annual return for a charitable fundraising authority in NSW.
intro:
If you or your organisation hold an authority to fundraise in NSW, you must lodge an annual return within 6 months of the end of the financial year.

The return must be lodged even if no appeal has been held, and no money received.
who_can_apply: All holders of an authority to fundraise.
ACNC registered organisations that also hold a NSW authority to fundraise.
what_you_need: Your charitable fundraising authority number (CFN) which must match the registered number.

how_to_steps.text: You'll have the option to log in using your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to lodge an annual return.
Download Charitable fundraising – annual return – PDF.
Email your information to the address on the form.

contact: If you have any questions about a charitable fundraising authority email NSW Fair Trading or call 13 32 20.

more_info.text: For more information go to the NSW Fair Trading Charitable Fundraising Guidelines.

internal_links.text: Change the details on a charitable fundraising authority

faqs.q: When must I lodge the annual return?
faqs.a: You must lodge an annual return within 6 months of the end of the financial year.

faqs.q: Do I need to lodge the return even if no money was received?
faqs.a: Yes, the return must be lodged even if no appeal has been held and no money was received.

faqs.q: How can I meet my reporting obligations to both ACNC and NSW?
faqs.a: You can meet both obligations by providing your NSW annual return and statement of compliance with your ACNC Annual Information Statement (AIS) directly to the ACNC portal.
